newsitem.title: USA: Investors group buys into NUR Advanced.
newsitem.headline: Investors group buys into NUR Advanced.

text.p: A private investor group has bought about 36 percent of the capital stock of NUR Advanced Technologies Ltd, the company said Tuesday.
NUR, a printer maker, said a group formed by Josephthal Lyon & Ross Inc had bought the stock from Moshe Nur, NUR's former chairman.
It said Josephthal had committed itself to providing additional working capital and managerial support to the company after buying the stake.
As a result of the purchase, Dan Purjes was elected NUR chairman and Ehud Sarig was named president, NUR said.
Sarig is chief executive officer of NUR and Purjes is chairman of Josephthal, it added.
